reference: MySQL 8.4.4 (InnoDB, strict mode); MariaDB 10.11 is a separate repository reference
scope: DDL rejection is intentional divergence. DECLARATION_POLICY is provenance, never certification of legacy rows. Only SQL mutations are supported for integrity; privileged raw IPROTO writes are outside the contract.

FOREIGN KEY.partitioned_tables: also rejected; MySQL's own partition/FK refusal remains separate

CHECK.null_semantics: no CHECK truth evaluation is advertised; both ENFORCED and NOT ENFORCED declarations/ALTER enforcement are refused

ENUM/SET.legacy: old lists were normalized to TEXT and cannot be reconstructed

NOT NULL.existing_data: validated by ALTER before publication; no legacy data certification from provenance

UNIQUE.null_semantics: multiple keys containing NULL are allowed; non-NULL duplicates are refused; existing data is checked before publishing a new index

rejections.sql: CREATE TABLE denied(id INT PRIMARY KEY,v INT,FOREIGN KEY(v) REFERENCES p(id))
CREATE TABLE denied(id INT PRIMARY KEY,v INT,CONSTRAINT fk FOREIGN KEY(v) REFERENCES p(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE)
CREATE TABLE denied(id INT PRIMARY KEY,v INT,FOREIGN KEY(v) REFERENCES p(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE NO ACTION)

CREATE TABLE denied(id INT PRIMARY KEY,v INT REFERENCES p(id))
CREATE TABLE denied(id INT PRIMARY KEY,v INT,FOREIGN KEY(v) REFERENCES p(id)) PARTITION BY KEY(id)

ALTER TABLE t ADD CONSTRAINT ck CHECK(v>0)
